name: virtual-anchor-monorepo

scripts.release: pnpm build && node scripts/prepare-package.mjs && changeset publish
scripts.check:package: pnpm build && node scripts/prepare-package.mjs && node scripts/check-package.mjs

Revisit when typescript-eslint ships TS 7 support: https://github.com/typescript-eslint/typescript-eslint/issues/10940
